title: Expose source-authorized superseded Timeline Entry status through the existing Case HTTP read
goal: Mark an older authorized Case Timeline Entry non-current when and only when another authorized visible version supersedes it, reusing the existing read-only owner projection and HTTP route. No mutation, owner transfer, or new data source. Display the server-derived non-current state directly beside the authorized older Timeline Entry in the existing local analyst view.
invariants: Case/Timeline Entry and independently typed source authorization run unchanged before projection; client cannot assert supersession.
Only existing source-owner supersedes references already validated against the current visible authorized set may set read-only superseded=true.
No disclosure of denied/missing/foreign successor IDs; absence of an authorized successor never implies a definitive claim that no successor exists.
Existing Case HTTP route and page shape preserved; additive superseded field is omitted on false, no new IAM, mutation, audit side effects, or report/export permission.
Analyst JS treats superseded as an optional server-authoritative boolean, displays no successor ID or fabricated current status, preserves existing navigation ACL and legacy payload support.
security_properties: Never infer supersession from absent/denied/foreign successor entries.
Reject invalid version links as before; do not relax bounded projection or owner policies.
A denial yields no entries, including supersession metadata.

migration.rationale: Optional read-only computed JSON projection metadata; no persistent schema or data migration.

rollback.strategy: Revert additive projection field and marking loop, leaving source-owned Supersedes links intact.
verification: Existing source-safe projection and HTTP tests pass
Legacy JSON without visible successors unchanged

inputs: E10-INV-110E VERIFIED; existing Go Case/Timeline typed-source access and HTTP pagination
outputs: Authorized superseded predecessors are explicitly flagged in the existing Case Timeline JSON response, including paginated and filtered reads without a new endpoint.
Positive and denied-source Go projection/HTTP regression proof, preserving original version links and limiting inference.
Existing local analyst Case Timeline renders superseded source-owned entries with a clearly labeled non-current status, without guessing the presence of any inaccessible successor.
acceptance_tests: Source-authorized version1 and version2 where version2 supersedes version1 must mark only version1 as superseded.
Multi-hop authorized version chain marks all old nodes without manufacturing a single canonical successor.
Denied, missing and foreign successor must never change the visible predecessor flag or disclose its ID.
Explicit HTTP request with Case bearer shows boolean for predecessor even when newer entry is on another authorized page; invalid/revoked Case denied.
Existing Go tests and relevant GitHub Actions succeed on the exact SHA, no claims of production auth.

Node analyst UI test renders a server-asserted superseded flag on the predecessor and no non-current claim on a legacy record without the flag; rejects malformed flags without rendering entry content.

performance_budget.rationale: One O(N) pass over at most 5000 already-authorized entries with existing map; no new provider calls or storage.

definition_of_ready: E10-INV-110E VERIFIED, existing Project and HTTP owner integration accessible, no changes required to frozen Wazuh PR #187
definition_of_done: Same read-only HTTP endpoint emits correct status under existing source ACL
Exact candidate SHA passes Go unit/HTTP tests, race, static gates
Independent risk review of material source-visibility projection before acceptance
